name: Keeping the Light On
summary: Sister Rowland asks you to bring Holy Candles to Farholde Keep. She keeps them burning in the church crypt for the fallen, so their sacrifices are remembered.

sections.title: Candles for the Fallen
sections.body: Sister Rowland at Farholde Keep asks you for Holy Candles. Though service no longer takes place at the church, she keeps candles lit on the graves of the fallen in its crypt. Their flames are a sign that the dead are remembered and their sacrifices were not in vain. Marla, a friend of Sister Rowland, may have candles to spare in the house just outside the church.

faq.q: Why does Sister Rowland keep candles lit?
faq.answer: Sister Rowland keeps candles lit on the graves in the church crypt so the fallen are remembered and their sacrifices are not in vain.

faq.q: Where does Sister Rowland want the candles brought?
faq.answer: Sister Rowland asks you to bring Holy Candles to her at Farholde Keep.
Marla is a friend of Sister Rowland who lives in the house just outside the church and may have candles to spare.

faq.q: Is there still service at the church?
faq.answer: No service is held at the church now, though Sister Rowland continues to keep candles burning in its crypt.
